$comment: draft v0 — WO-048. Per-café configuration, used as the onboarding seed (cafes/<slug>/info.json) and as the body of a published configuration version. Not frozen: becomes schemaVersion 1 with release v0.1.0. Cross-field rules that JSON Schema cannot express (default language is enabled, every order-type channel is an enabled module that provides checkout.channel, module dependencies, the pinned release is in the window) are checked by the config validator; see docs/architecture/modules.md.
title: DigiMenu café configuration
description: Everything that makes one café different from another: identity, languages, opening hours, ordering, modules and settings, and the release it starts on. Never contains code, secrets or personal data.

$schema.description: Optional pointer used by code editors for autocompletion.

schemaVersion.description: Format version of this file. 0 = draft (WO-048).

slug.description: Permanent café identifier used in every printed link: /<slug>/t/<table>. Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, 2 to 32 characters. Never changed once a card is printed. Some words are reserved for platform routes.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Only 'demo' and 'fixture' may appear in the public repository.

names.description: Café name as shown to customers. French is required; Arabic and English fall back to French.

enabled.description: Languages the customer can switch between.

default.description: Used when the phone's language is not enabled. Must be one of 'enabled' (validator rule).

unavailable.description: How sold-out items appear: greyed with a text label, or hidden.

info.description: Public café information (C-06). Business contact only: never a staff member's personal number.

phone.description: The café's public business number in international format, e.g. +216 followed by 8 digits.

googleReviewUrl.description: Needed by the google_review module (M-14). Without it the validator warns and the module stays off.

hours.description: Opening hours in Tunis time (C-07). A day that is missing or empty means closed. A closing time earlier than the opening time means after midnight.

primaryColor.description: Accent colour. The core checks text contrast (WCAG 2.1 AA) before publishing.

buttonColor.description: Optional colour for filled buttons, for brands whose primary colour is too light for them (ADR-0012). Absent: buttons use primaryColor, darkened to pass contrast. Checked with the same contrast rules.

logo.description: Path of the logo inside the café's media folder.

ordering.description: Which order types the café accepts and through which channel. An empty 'types' object means menu and show-to-waiter only.

prepMinutes.description: Earliest pickup slot = now + prepMinutes, within opening hours.

areaNote.description: Fixed note on delivery area and fee. No zone pricing.

dineInDetails.description: Whether first name and phone are required for dine-in orders (C-15, D-027).

maxOrderTotal.description: Largest order total accepted, in millimes (300000 = 300,000 DT).

modules.description: Module switches and settings, keyed by module key. A module that is not listed is off. Settings are checked against the module's own settings schema by the validator.

release.description: Release the café starts on. After onboarding the live pin is data in the database and changes only through the pin action (docs/architecture/releases.md).

millimes.description: Money as whole millimes: 4500 means 4,500 DT.
